owner_prefix.scope: Gateway-time owner facts from received prefix; ledger admission linearization, not exact RequestMark time. No native phase, readiness, cancellation, GPU retirement or residual inferred.

phases.scope: Trusted clocked acquisition plus bound initial closure and actual-offer public memory. Phase/owner facts at historical native source T only. Later Gateway receipt closes T; it does not advance native state to decision time or provide ingress/release/HTTP residuals.
